name: shape-it
description: Plan a piece of work by reading the project first, deciding everything it can already answer, and asking only what is expensive to reverse. Batched multiple-choice questions, then a written plan. Ships with `domain`, which maintains the project's DOMAIN.md and docs/decisions/ so vocabulary and hard-to-reverse decisions outlive the plan, and `domain-adopt`, a manual-only pass that seeds a model into a project that has none. Works on a codebase or on a project made of documents and records.
